integrity.euler_basis: For an algebraic C* action, compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus; the proof is included via Rosenlicht stratification and C*-bundle Euler vanishing.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: arXiv:math/0311388 lists its first submission on 2003-11-21.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A base-B one-parameter subgroup gives pairwise distinct ambient tensor-coordinate weights; every ambient fixed coordinate line is decomposable and lies on the Segre variety.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The same Segre-secant literature is algebraic geometry; arXiv:math/0609054 lists MSC 14M12 and arXiv:math/0601452 is indexed with 14Q15.
integrity.secant_basis: Archival sources define higher secant varieties of Segre products and identify them with tensor border-rank loci.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary Segre embeddings with at least three factors; Segre--Veronese embeddings are not covered.
The cumulative statement uses ordinary topological Euler characteristic because the secant varieties are projective; exact border-rank strata use compactly supported Euler characteristic.
Euler characteristic is coarse, so vanishing on higher exact border-rank strata gives no finer homotopy classification.
The proof is short after combining torus localization with a separating one-parameter subgroup, so an unindexed prior observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic is constant along every higher Segre secant tower
